properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued for Wake County in central North Carolina
properties.description: At 1210 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located near Garner, moving northeast at 30 mph. HAZARD...Tornado. SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation. Not markup
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building.
Avoid windows.
